analysis: Wednesday's morning session deepened the post-record pullback: the driver is a genuinely hot September PMI (57 vs 53.6 expected) that pushed the 10Y to a 29-year high, sharpening the hawkish-Fed narrative (Goldman now expects another 25bp hike at the Oct 27-28 meeting). The day's idiosyncratic news mostly leans idiosyncratic-but-heavy: McDonald's sold off on its own Investor Day capex plan, GOOGL is the weak Mag-7 leg, while IonQ/Palantir moved on real company announcements. META remains the AI-trade bid into tonight's Connect keynote, continuing the Muse-app momentum. Signal: rates and oil are the macro overhang; noise: the memory-chip cooldown after two-day breakouts is orderly (Micron volume 25% below normal).
